job.purpose: S81 gather (dsfd_sp_gather_c, 2.9 M flops flat, does not fit its slot): hardened 4-root leaf of the gather cluster (E half: lanes enter E, leave W). Each root = ot_s81ph_ret_root_s (step B, S = 16 open rows: coordinator rule, real bound <= 8 -> S = 16): input queue in a 128 x 66 1R1W array, CAM-free pairing store {open-row slot, parent node} in a 512 x 34 array; cycle-identical to ot_s81ph_ret_root_p inside both capacities, sticky fault on a 17th open row. Lanes W -> E: 276 b end here, 828 b cross both stacks through the N / S channels (~2.1k M2 + M4 tracks: 0.51 at the first stack); chain N -> S 636 -> 848 b along the band (M3 / M5).
